title: Prime Day Hasn’t Started Yet, but I’ve Already Found Deals Worth Buying
gist: Amazon's second sale of the year, Prime Big Deal Days, runs October 6-7, with early discounts already live on WIRED-tested gear such as the Google Pixel 10a ($424), Pixel Buds Pro 2 ($190) and Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro ($550); most discounts are modest (roughly 9-45%), and several are matched at Best Buy and Walmart.

themes.theme: Prime Big Deal Days timing and pricing

insights.claim: Amazon's second Prime sale of the year, Prime Big Deal Days, runs October 6 and 7, with early deals already live in late September.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Kicks off the holiday retail calendar; a read on consumer electronics demand ahead of Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
insights.locator: Amazon Prime Day deals are back

insights.claim: Many early Prime Day deals are price-matched by Best Buy, Walmart and brand direct stores, e.g. the Google Pixel 10a at $424 at Amazon, Best Buy and the Google Store.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Competing retailers are matching Amazon event pricing, limiting Amazon's share-shift advantage.
insights.locator: A Killer Deal on Our Favorite

insights.claim: Several featured discounts are shallow or recurring: the Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 deal appears regularly, the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 3P is $20 above its all-time low, and the Smartish wallet is only $5 off.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Suggests muted early-event discounting on consumer electronics accessories.
insights.locator: We see this deal for our

insights.claim: The Google Pixel 10a, WIRED's favorite Android phone, is $424, 15% off its $499 list price, positioned on value plus years of software and security updates.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Google's budget Pixel is the headline phone deal, a signal of its push for Android share on price.

insights.claim: The Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro robot vacuum is $550, 31% off its $800 list and the lowest price since launch.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Deep robot-vacuum discounting reflects a competitive, price-driven category.

insights.claim: The Netvue Birdfy Lite smart bird feeder with AI bird identification and solar charging is $144, 42% off, with a range of configurations sold with or without AI ID.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Shows AI features being tiered and upsold even in niche consumer gadgets.

insights.claim: Other early deals include Bose Ultra Open Earbuds at $199 ($100 off), the Razer Cobra HyperSpeed mouse at a record-low $79, and the Shark PowerDetect cordless vacuum at $430.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Broad-based, modest discounting across consumer hardware brands ahead of the holiday quarter.
